description: spend.report is the spend over time, grouped: the window is echoed back as the store's own timestamp shape (the client sees what was actually read), and each bucket carries the USD floor with P31's honesty marks — exact says when the floor is a total, the partial/unknown counts say what it is not, so a sum that hides an unknown cannot read as a fact. Buckets are sorted by key; a bucket with no priced tokens at all omits tokens.
